raw_response:
This millet plot is only 0.06 hectare and I am renting it, so I will not spend much cash on it. I have my own land to think about, and a bag of fertilizer from the cooperative is too big and too expensive for such a small piece. I will plant local seed that I kept from last year, and my family will do all the work — there is no money to hire anyone. I do not use chemicals on millet, and there is no irrigation water here anyway.
